page.overview:
Who is Char-Ryl-Roy?

Char-Ryl-Roy was a Cerean male Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the High Republic Era. Roy, along with fellow Jedi Master Creighton Sun, Jedi Knight Gella Nattai, and Roy's Padawan Enya Keen traveled to Eiram aboard the Longbeam cruiser Valiant on a mission to deliver medical supplies. Char-Ryl-Roy wielded a green-bladed lightsaber.

Char-Ryl-Roy appeared in the 2022 novel The High Republic: Convergence, written by Zoraida Córdova for the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project. A picture of Char-Ryl-Roy in Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi later confirmed that the Jedi from Characters of Star Wars: The High Republic was indeed Char-Ryl-Roy.

He was originally planned to be named Charl Roy, however it was changed to Char-Ryl-Roy to match similar naming structure with other Cereans.

Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi
